verdict.rationale: Bento documents that every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible, and it tracks drift across prompt versions. Its 'nudges' ship in shadow mode and graduate to 100% traffic, which suggests some runtime rollout. However, skills and rules live in the user's repo as Markdown/YAML, so deploying prompt changes to production without a code deploy is not clearly documented. missing for 10: an explicit runtime prompt registry or fetch-at-runtime mechanism, a documented no-code-deploy prompt promotion workflow, environment/label-based prompt deployment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code

citations.quote: Every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix, and graduates to 100% traffic only if it provably helps.
